notes: Cross-platform development packages built from one pinned BPlayer source revision.
Release assets are mirrored publicly while the application source remains private.
Android and Windows are self-signed; iOS and macOS are ad-hoc signed development builds.
The public Android App Bundle excludes the ProGuard debugging map while retaining its original self-signed identity.

assets.name: Android APK
assets.installNotes: Installable self-signed development APK. Future BPlayer upgrades must use the same signing identity.

assets.name: Android App Bundle
assets.installNotes: Self-signed publishing bundle for authorized testing or store preparation; it is not directly installable. The public bundle excludes the ProGuard debugging map.

assets.name: iOS application archive
assets.installNotes: Ad-hoc signed development archive. It still requires authorized signing and provisioning before installation on an iPhone or iPad.

assets.name: macOS application
assets.installNotes: Ad-hoc signed but not notarized. Follow macOS and organization security policy before use.

assets.name: Windows application
assets.installNotes: Extract the complete ZIP and keep every file together. The executable has a stable self-signed Authenticode development signature.
